predecessors.name: Kingdom of Romania (Greater Romania)
predecessors.text: Romania within the frontiers of the 1947 peace treaty, the Kingdom's last shape (238,172 km2)

successors.name: Romania
successors.text: the same land under the name Romania from 28 December 1989

ledger.x: 1947: the monarchy ends and the People's Republic begins.
1965: the Romanian People's Republic becomes the Socialist Republic of Romania.
1989: Ceaușescu falls and the Socialist Republic ends.

certainty.note: Treaty frontiers of 1947 (Northern Transylvania restored, Bessarabia and Northern Bukovina to the Soviet Union, Southern Dobruja to Bulgaria), unchanged to 1989; the pages opened give no survey detail.
